MEMOIR WEDGEWOOD HOUSTON

NASHVILLE, TN

CONTEMPORARY URBAN LIVING

CHAPTER I: WHAT IS MEMOIR?

A novel approach to contemporary apartment living in Nashville.




Every chapter of life deserves a beautiful home, regardless of how long you plan to stay. Memoir Wedgewood Houston creates inspired
 residential experiences that empower you to live your best chapter
. 





Memoir offers elevated design
, amplified amenities, flexible leasing options, and an emphasis on beautiful shared spaces all set within iconic neighborhoods.

Schedule a Tour
CHAPTER II: APARTMENTS




Memoir Wedgewood Houston provides Studio
, One-Bedroom
, and Two-Bedroom 
apartments with unique touches, including antique brass hardware, custom tile, and your choice of Ivory or Navy interior finishes.




Each apartment features exposed concrete ceilings and industrial-inspired, operable awning windows. These interior details and the factory-style brick facade are an homage to Wedgewood Houston’s history as a bustling industrial hub. Designers drew specific inspiration from the May Hosiery Mills, which first opened on Chestnut Street in 1909.

CHAPTER III: AMPLIFIED AMENITIES

We know a thing or two about hospitality. Every Memoir includes on-site concierge, a full-service coffee and cocktail bar, a 24/7 fitness studio, an extraordinary pool deck, and ample indoor/outdoor entertaining spaces.



Explore Amenities

CHAPTER IV: WEDGEWOOD HOUSTON

Here in Wedgewood Houston, the spirit of innovation walks hand in hand with a profound appreciation for history. The neighborhood is known for its vibrant art galleries, friendly bartenders, a burgeoning culinary scene, and iconic
 guitar-shaped scoreboard.

MEMOIR MAY HOSIERY

NASHVILLE, TN

NOW LEASING

CHAPTER I: WHAT IS MEMOIR?




A novel approach to contemporary apartment living in Nashville.




Every chapter of life deserves a beautiful home, regardless of how long you plan to stay. Memoir creates inspired
 residential experiences that empower you to live your best chapter
.





Memoir May Hosiery sits across from the historic May Hosiery Mills in Wedgewood Village, a destination for fashion, art, music, and entertainment.



Learn More
CHAPTER II: APARTMENTS

Memoir May Hosiery offers studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments with elevated touches: industrial-inspired windows, high ceilings, antique brass hardware, hand-crafted
 tile made in Nashville, and choice of ivory or green finishes. Select units include terraces overlooking Wedgewood Village or the skylight between Alla Vita and Momotaro.

Explore Apartments

Apartment Terrace

Apartment Kitchen

Two-Bedroom Apartment

Studio Apartment

Apartment Dining Room

CHAPTER III: CURATED AMENITIES

Enjoy curated amenities with hospitality-inspired
 design: a rooftop pool with custom tile mural, two amenity lounges with wet bars, billiards, and a 24/7 fitness studio. The building is also home to two James Beard-recognized restaurants, Momotaro and Alla Vita, a new cocktail bar, Perenn Grocery, and neighborhood bookstore Bell Bird Books.

Explore Amenities

Lobby Living Room

Rooftop Pool with Cabanas

Amenity Lounge with Wet Bar

24/7 Fitness Studio

Amenity Lounge with Billiard Table

CHAPTER IV: WEDGEWOOD VILLAGE

Memoir May Hosiery is located at 1210 Martin St., across from the historic
 May Hosiery Mills in Wedgewood Village. Building upon the fabric of Wedgewood Houston as a crossroads for culture and commerce
, Wedgewood Village is a destination for fashion, art, music, and entertainment just south of downtown Nashville in a long industrial part of town.

Building overview

Preserve the spirit, forge the community. Standard Assembly is multi-use residential, retail, and gathering space located at - and made for - the center of Nashville's historic Wedgewood Houston neighborhood. Explore amenities and features offered in our studio, 1, or 2 bedroom apartments for rent. Wedgewood Houston is Nashville's best kept secret, and we're here to support the neighborhood and promote what it's all about - honoring its locals and their talents. we're surrounded by makers, small businesses, and big names. The neighborhood's eclectic mix of activity allows for constant growth and improvement. Contact us at Standard Assembly today to find your next perfect home! we're glad to be along for the ride.

Building overview

Preserve the spirit, forge the community. Standard Assembly is multi-use residential, retail, and gathering space located at - and made for - the center of Nashville's historic Wedgewood Houston neighborhood. Explore amenities and features offered in our studio, 1, or 2 bedroom apartments for rent. Wedgewood Houston is Nashville's best kept secret, and we're here to support the neighborhood and promote what it's all about - honoring its locals and their talents. we're surrounded by makers, small businesses, and big names. The neighborhood's eclectic mix of activity allows for constant growth and improvement. Contact us at Standard Assembly today to find your next perfect home! we're glad to be along for the ride.

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/popmotion/11.0.5/popmotion.min.js"></script>
<script>
	const { animate, spring } = window.popmotion;
	let currentSlide = 0;
	let animatedSlides = []; // Initialize as empty array
	const slideInterval = 6000;
	let autoplayInterval;

	// Function to split text into individual word spans
	function wrapWords(element) {
		const html = element.innerHTML;
		const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
		tempDiv.innerHTML = html;

		const processNode = (node) => {
			if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
				const text = node.textContent.trim();
				if (text.length === 0) return document.createTextNode(' ');

				const words = text.split(/(\s+)/);
				const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

				words.forEach(word => {
					if (word.match(/\s+/)) {
						fragment.appendChild(document.createTextNode(word));
					} else if (word.length > 0) {
						const span = document.createElement('span');
						span.className = 'word';
						span.textContent = word;
						fragment.appendChild(span);
					}
				});

				return fragment;
			} else if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
				const newNode = node.cloneNode(false);
				Array.from(node.childNodes).forEach(child => {
					const processed = processNode(child);
					newNode.appendChild(processed);
				});
				return newNode;
			}
			return node.cloneNode(true);
		};

		element.innerHTML = '';
		Array.from(tempDiv.childNodes).forEach(child => {
			const processed = processNode(child);
			element.appendChild(processed);
		});
	}

	// Animate words with spring physics
	function animateWords(element) {
		const words = element.querySelectorAll('.word');

		words.forEach((word, index) => {
			// Reset initial state
			word.style.opacity = '0';
			word.style.transform = 'translateY(50px) scale(0.8)';
			word.style.filter = 'blur(10px)';

			const delay = index * 80; // 80ms stagger

			setTimeout(() => {
				// Animate opacity
				animate({
					from: 0,
					to: 1,
					duration: 600,
					onUpdate: (latest) => {
						word.style.opacity = latest;
					}
				});

				// Animate blur
				animate({
					from: 10,
					to: 0,
					duration: 600,
					onUpdate: (latest) => {
						word.style.filter = `blur(${latest}px)`;
					}
				});

				// Animate position and scale with spring
				spring({
					from: { y: 50, scale: 0.8 },
					to: { y: 0, scale: 1 },
					stiffness: 100,
					damping: 12,
					mass: 1,
					onUpdate: (latest) => {
						word.style.transform = `translateY(${latest.y}px) scale(${latest.scale})`;
					}
				});
			}, delay);
		});
	}

	// Function to change slides
	function goToSlide(index) {
		// Fade out current slide
		animatedSlides[currentSlide].style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
		animatedSlides[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');

		currentSlide = index;

		// Fade in new slide
		setTimeout(() => {
			animatedSlides[currentSlide].classList.add('active');

			// Animate all .slide-text elements in the new slide
			const activeSlide = animatedSlides[currentSlide];
			const textElements = activeSlide.querySelectorAll('.slide-text');
			
			textElements.forEach(element => {
				animateWords(element);
			});
		}, 100);

		clearInterval(autoplayInterval);
		startAutoplay();
	}

	function startAutoplay() {
		autoplayInterval = setInterval(() => {
			const nextSlide = (currentSlide + 1) % animatedSlides.length;
			goToSlide(nextSlide);
		}, slideInterval);
	}

	// Initialize
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
		// Query slides after DOM is loaded
		animatedSlides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
		
		// Wrap all headings and subtext
